svg.title: A fixed out-of-distribution advection–diffusion forecast
svg.desc: AD19 trajectory0, first training seed, clean context. Pure vector cells display every timepoint and fourth spatial point; full temporal sampling avoids rendering-induced aliasing atc100. Prediction is not chosen by test performance.
